description.value: E-Mart is a small Filipino ethnic convenience store in Sechelt on the Sunshine Coast, stocking over 300 traditional Filipino food products including fresh, frozen, and shelf-stable items such as Aling Mary fresh goods, tocino, longanisa, lumpia, and a wide range of Filipino sauces and canned goods. The store also functions as an I-Remit money transfer agent and LBC Box Agent, making it a community hub for the local Filipino diaspora. Touring cyclists passing through Sechelt will find a distinctive specialty grocery stop with products unavailable at mainstream supermarkets.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at emartfilipinostore.weebly.com confirms an active Filipino convenience store at 5520 Inlet Avenue, Sechelt, BC, with store phone (604) 747-2552. The website describes over 300 Filipino food products (fresh, frozen, shelf) confirming the Groceries category. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those are left null.
concerns: OSM name is 'Emart' but website consistently uses 'E-Mart' — consider updating the OSM record.
OSM opening_hours tag (Mo-Sa 12:00-18:00) conflicts with the website (Monday to Saturday 10:00 am to 6:00 pm); website value is likely more current.
OSM has no address or phone; both were sourced from website only and could not be cross-checked against OSM.
URL was discovered (medium confidence) rather than taken directly from an OSM tag — confirmed correct by matching business name, address, and content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible convenience store confirmed by a live website with address, phone, and product details. Useful resupply stop for touring cyclists on the Sunshine Coast.
enrichment_extras.notes: The store also offers after-hours emergency/appointment shopping via the home phone number (604) 885-5787, which may be useful for cyclists needing supplies outside regular hours.
